title: Federated Learning and Distributed Intelligence
description: My research focuses on developing efficient and adaptive distributed intelligence systems, with particular emphasis on federated learning under heterogeneous data, communication constraints, and dynamic environments.

publications.highlight: We develop communication-efficient optimization methods for distributed large-scale model training by integrating real-time system feedback.
We propose a fair federated learning framework to improve robustness and fairness under heterogeneous data distributions.
We investigate emerging challenges and opportunities in efficient federated learning systems.

title: AI for Science
description: My research explores artificial intelligence methods for scientific discovery by integrating machine learning, domain knowledge, and complex scientific data analysis.

publications.highlight: We develop AI-driven approaches to transportation.

title: Multi-Agent Intelligence and Communications
description: My research investigates intelligent coordination and communication mechanisms for multi-agent systems, including UAV networks, connected vehicles, and autonomous systems.

publications.highlight: We study communication-efficient coordination strategies for autonomous multi-agent systems.
